sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 311 resolves heavily damaged canonical OCR in U001651 and states that, `Unserer triebpsychologischen Auffassung nach`, the katatone syndrome may be understood as a spontaneous Heilungsversuch / Abwehr against paranoide Wahnbildungen and krankhafte Egodiastole.

The later source summary explicitly uses `vermutlich`: `Der katatone Symptomkomplex ist vermutlich ein unbewußter Schutz- und Abwehrvorgang gegen die paranoiden Wahnbildungen und Sinnestäuschungen. Er ist eine Art von spontanem Heilungsversuch.` This qualifier governs assertion strength.

sourceExcerpt: Der katatone Symptomkomplex ist vermutlich ein unbewußter Schutz- und Abwehrvorgang gegen die paranoiden Wahnbildungen und Sinnestäuschungen.
romanianRendering: În rezumatul său triebpsychologisch, Szondi spune cu calificativul `vermutlich` că simptomcomplexul katatonic ar fi un proces inconștient de Schutz und Abwehr împotriva construcțiilor paranoide și îl numește o formă de `spontaner Heilungsversuch`.
doctrinalStatement: Interpretarea katatoniei ca Schutz-/Abwehrvorgang împotriva paranoide Wahnbildungen și ca `spontaner Heilungsversuch` este o ipoteză explicită a modelului lui Szondi, nu o definiție certă: sursa o introduce prin `Unserer triebpsychologischen Auffassung nach` / `kann man ... auffassen` și o rezumă ulterior cu `vermutlich`. Ea trebuie păstrată la forță probabilistică și nu transformată într-un adevăr clinic general sau într-o recomandare terapeutică.
conditions: Use only as Szondi's historical triebpsychological interpretation of the katatone symptom complex in the schizophrenia discussion.
exceptions: Do not remove the source qualifier `vermutlich`.
Do not infer that katatonic phenomena are beneficial, curative or therapeutically desirable from the historical phrase `spontaner Heilungsversuch`.
Do not generalize the hypothesized protection relation beyond the source context without separate doctrine.
scopeNotes: The phrase `spontaner Heilungsversuch` is source terminology and is retained without modern therapeutic endorsement.
The two five-phase sequences represented in DR_SZ_TRIEBPATH_2_000016 are the source's structural elaboration of this hypothesis.

relations.note: The phase sequences provide the source's structural account of the hypothesized Schutz-/Abwehr process.

ambiguities: Canonical U001651 is severely OCR-damaged; admitted PDF printed page 311 resolves the wording. The later U001687 summary independently confirms the key interpretation and its `vermutlich` qualifier.
reviewNotes: Canonical BODY U001651 and U001686-U001690 checked against deterministic P0 evidence; admitted PDF printed pages 311-313 visually reconsulted.
P2A only; the historical hypothesis remains non-executable.
